body: Implementation and verification (2026-11-23): added shared AcpWorkerClient with correlated bounded JSON-RPC requests, streamed update events, negotiated initialize capabilities/auth methods, client-request routing, conservative cancel/reject defaults, session cancellation and owned child process shutdown. Resume is gated by loadSession and verified with a fresh process. Cursor and Codex use separate launch definitions; delegateToCodex now uses the shared client while retaining the project root for process cwd, session/new cwd, and prompt scope. Six isolated tests pass (streaming, capability/resume gating, unknown blocking request failure, default cancellation for permission/plan, pending permission cancellation, process exit). The opt-in same live contract plus resume test passed against both installed providers from /private/tmp.
